title: Belgium Orders 20 Skyranger 30 Air Defence Systems From Rheinmetall, With Deliveries From Late 2028
excerpt: Rheinmetall signed a contract worth several hundred million euros to supply Belgium with 20 Skyranger 30 systems, to be used from fixed positions against drones and other airborne threats.
rank_math_title: Belgium orders 20 Skyranger 30 from Rheinmetall | Envanter Medya
rank_math_description: Rheinmetall signed a several-hundred-million-euro deal for 20 Skyranger 30 systems for Belgium. Deliveries start at the end of 2028 and tie into the Blue Dome network.
